A1.justification: Both readable, 12-page PDFs describe the same sparse-kernel decomposition work. However, both end with references and omit the appendix cited for a derivation, sampling instructions, and supplementary experiments, limiting comparison of those materials.

before.justification: V1 reports original kernel-approximation experiments, spatially varying filtering results, mobile-device timings, and initialization/configuration ablations in Section 5 and Figures 2–7.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results in Section 5 and Figures 2–7.

M1.justification: The documented sparse-layer representation, learnable offsets and weights, initialization strategies, filter-space interpolation, impulse-response supervision, and Charbonnier loss remain unchanged. The new known-target-kernel qualification does not introduce a different algorithm.

E1.justification: The supplied material retains the same Gaussian, geometric, non-convex, and optical kernels, five photographs, and tilt-shift, rotational, and radial filtering scenarios. V2's emphasis on multidimensional filtering describes coverage already present in v1.

E2.justification: PST (Schuster et al., 2020) and LowRank (McGraw, 2015) remain the comparators in the corresponding experiments. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains the optimizer and learning-rate schedule, 1,000 proposed-method optimization steps, PST's 10,000 iterations with 10 parallel candidates, LowRank ranks, evaluation metrics, and mobile timing platform. The displayed experimental configurations also match.

E4.justification: Figures 6–7 retain the same Flower/Dove initialization comparisons and Ring layer/sample ablations. However, both versions refer to unavailable appendix ablations on Gaussian kernels and initialization/regularization strategies, preventing comparison of those supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained PST parallel-candidate count describes optimization, not a new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: The displayed score entries, images, timings, and convergence curves in Figures 2–7 match. However, the supplementary quantitative evaluations explicitly referenced in Section 5.4 are missing from both PDFs, so changes to the complete result set cannot be established.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 and the accessible mathematical construction are unchanged. Both versions defer the radial-initialization step-size derivation to an absent appendix, preventing comparison of that derivation.

C1.justification: V2's abstract, introduction, and conclusion explicitly restrict applicability to having the dense target kernel available during optimization and filtering. This qualifies the retained claims about differentiable decomposition, initialization, efficient interpolation, and filtering quality.

C2.justification: V2 newly states the known-target requirement as a limitation. Section 4.2 changes preventing poor local optima to reducing their risk, while Section 5.2 interprets the retained evidence more narrowly as approximation accuracy rather than general optimization robustness.

D1.justification: V2 explicitly describes single-resolution processing in Section 2.1; the hardware, optimizer, and budget disclosures otherwise match. Detailed sampling instructions remain deferred to an appendix absent from both PDFs, preventing a complete assessment of reproducibility-detail changes.

R1.justification: The bibliography is unchanged. Section 2.1 adds a contrast with Dual Filtering's reconstruction work and potential detail loss, and Section 2.3 more explicitly positions the method as filling a gap in differentiable sparse approximation and spatially varying synthesis.

P1.justification: V2 substantially rewrites and condenses the abstract, introduction, related work, and portions of the method motivation, results discussion, and conclusion. It introduces the DISK title, revises the author block, adds conference headers and acknowledgments, and retains the overall section order.

P2.justification: The same seven figures are retained. V2 enlarges Figure 2's annotations, expands Figures 2 and 4 captions to explain error colors, and resizes/repositions Figure 3. Figure 2's 10^-4 scale annotation becomes visually obscured, although its underlying text and score entries remain.

improvement.justification: V2 provides clearer applicability boundaries, more measured optimization claims, and substantially tighter prose. These offer a modest overall improvement without new empirical support in the supplied pages. Figure 2's obscured scale is a local presentation regression, and the missing referenced appendices remain unresolved.
